'''Taskeed''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Originally known as '''Taskored''', it was absorbed into [[Xim's empire]] as [[Xim/Legends|he]] expanded his borders from the [[Kingdom of Cron]].<ref name="Atlas" /> During his campaigns, Xim tested a powerful weapon on Taskeed, leaving behind a massive crater that became known as the [[Pentakus Crater]].<ref name="Leaving a Mark" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="Atlas" />
